name: atk-player
description: Cross-platform animation playback and review application

ffmpeg.description: Media decoding and export via FFmpeg (milestone M1). LGPL components only: GPL and nonfree encoders stay disabled so the application can ship under the terms recorded in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.

$comment: Qt is NOT listed here on purpose.
Building Qt from source through vcpkg takes hours on Windows and produces
a toolchain the official binaries already provide. Qt is installed
separately (see docs/BUILDING.md) and found through CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH.
FFmpeg is behind the optional 'ffmpeg' feature so Phase 0 configures with
no dependency downloads at all. Enable it in M1 with:
'builtin-baseline' must be filled in with a vcpkg commit SHA when the
ffmpeg feature is first enabled, so dependency versions are reproducible.
